pages.text: $(li)$(l)Script does nothing:$() check for mislabeled interfaces and blocks that aren't connected; SFM silently skips those. Check the slot numbers with the network tool.

$(li)$(l)Disk deletes itself:$() some label names on niche blocks do this (known: NuclearCraft reactor parts); rename the labels. It also happened to several players on the first fuel push into a new fission reactor, so do that step by hand.

$(li)$(l)Editor crash:$() pressing down at the bottom of the script editor crashes with $(5)StringIndexOutOfBoundsException$(); avoid it.$(li)$(l)AE2 fluid cells$() can cause partitioning errors; make sure there are enough cells.
